tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi

cho ga rdo rje rol ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ sems kyi rdo rjer bzhag kyang mi g.yo ba/ /gzung 'dzin dri lan mar bcas rdo rje bzhi/ /sgyu mas rmongs gang dbang bzhi'i chu thigs kyis/ /rnam par gso mdzad dpa' bo gang des srungs/ /de la slob dpon dam tshig dang ldan zhing bsnyen pa yongs su dag pas/ slob ma rjes su bzung bar 'dod na de'i bya ba ni 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ thig tshon gyi bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor mngon par sgrub pa dang*/ dam tshig gi gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams so/ /de ltar brgyad las dang po ni/ dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang 'dra/ de rjes bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sar sa lha'i tshom bu mchod gtor dang bcas pa bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rus sbal gyi steng du/ pad zla'i gdan la paṃ las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yon pas gser gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa rang gi dpung pa'i rtsa bar thal mo mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ pri thi wī puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha baṃ hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang/ / sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ / bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /gtum chen drag po mchod pa yi/

/sna tshogs rin chen 'dzin pa'i sa/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang gyur gyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin bdag dkyil 'khor 'bri/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa'i phyogs gcig tu bzhugs par gyur/ nor 'dzin ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ / dkyil 'khor gyi gnas thams cad dri bzang gis byugs te/ lha gnas dgur thig le'i zlum po tshom bur bcas pa dgod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ro/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ zhes pa nas/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la hūṃ yig rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das khro bo gtum po sku mdog mthing ka in+ḍa ni la zhes pa nas/ ngo bor dag pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ shar du mi g.yo ba dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho ru mi g.yo ba ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu mi g.yo ba dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du mi g.yo ba ljang khu sna tshogs ut+pa las mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu phra ma rdo rje ma ser mo rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ nub byang du 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo pad+mas mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ byang shar du phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu ut+pa las mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ khro bo bzhi po rnams nas dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ / rangagi snying gar pad zla dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' gtum po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /de nas mchod pa rnams/

oṃ āḥ bighā nu ta sā da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gyis bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ bla med spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ shrī tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa bhaṭ+ṭa rā ga sa pā ri wa ra sad ka ra ya pād+yāṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ añtsa ma ṇaṃ/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ar+gha rnams kyis chu bzhi phul/ o shrī tsaṇ+ḍa sogs kyi mthar/ puṣ+pe nas shap+ta 'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa su/ zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud gang gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin te lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa bcu dang*/ /las thams cad pa'i bum pa ste bcu gcig gam/ ma rnyed na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis kyis kyang rung ste/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba lha'i gos kyis mgul chings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis gang ba'o/ / dung chos steng du bzhag ste/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ / ye shes bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ hūṃ me tog gi 'phreng ba bcing ba'i rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ ta bhe ta bhe ma hā ta bhe swāhā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā bkug ste 'dres par gyur/ bum pa bcu yod na dbus kyi gnyis la gtso bo yab yum gzhan rnams la phyogs mtshams kyi lha brgyad bskyed/ bum pa gnyis yin na rnam rgyal du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ las bum du slar yang mi g.yo ba ljang khu bskyed pa yin te/ de yang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su chos 'byungadakar po'i nang du nas/ 'dab ma brgyad pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das khro bo gtum po mthing ka sogs dang*/ shar du mi g.yo ba dkar po/ sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ byang dang las bum du mi g.yo ba ljang khu zhes 'don pa spo/ ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs te bstim pa yang gong gi lha sta gon bzhin no/

/ bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams kyang rigs lnga dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i ngo bor gyur/ pāt+ya nas/ shab+ta 'i bar gong bzhin mchod/ lha rnams dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ lag pa g.yon pas me tog gi 'phreng ba nas bzung ste/ so so'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzlas te/ me tog dkar po bdun gzhug par bya'o/ /las bum gyis bum pa thams cad la bsangs te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ hūṃ zhes brjod de/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blug par bya'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o// sta gon gyi rjes chog ni/ de nas gong bzhin dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas la/ bdug spos thogs te/ dpal ldan mi g.yo gtum pa'i lha/ /zhe sdang rdo rje ma dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i stobs kyis 'gro don du/ /'khor lo bdag ni bri bar bgyid/ /mchod pa'i don dang dbangabaskur na/ /'gro ba'i don la gzhol ba yi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro mas/ /rab tu dgyes pa mdzad pa'i rigs/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan rnams/ /bdag la 'dir ni dgongs su gsol/ /gtum po drag po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i don du bri bar bgyid/ rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge bdag /ji ltar nus pas mchod bgyid de/ /slob ma rnams dang bdag la yang*// rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor bar bcas thams cad kyis// nges par brtag par rigs pa lags/ /khyed cag sems can don mdzad pa'i/ / rang gi dam bca' dran par badzod/ ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas legs so zhes gnang ba sbyin nas de nyid du mi snang bar bsam mo/ /bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ smon lam gdab pa dang*/ shis brjod rnams bya'o/ /de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gnas pa la/

kye kye bzhin bzang rnams srid pa'i bde ba dag kyang yid brtan med pa 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can yin pa de'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum gyi go 'phang kho na don du gnyer bas dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o zhes bsgrags nas/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag stsol la/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ de nas skyabs 'gro sbyin pa ni/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / dam pa'i chos la'ang bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la'ang mi phyed dad/ / zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ srog gcod ma byin len pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi bud med brdzun smra rnams/ /lnga pa chang gi btung ba nyid/ /thams cad sbrul bzhin dor bar bya/ zhes bslab gzhi lnga bzung*/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong sbyin pa ni/ bdag gis sems can bsad mi bya/ /pha rol nor ni dbrog mi bya/ /bdag ni tshangs pa spyod pa spyad/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang spang bar bgyi/ /myos byed chang gi btung ba ni/ /bdag gis gang du'ang btung mi bya/ /gar dang glu dang rgyan rnams dang/ / dga' ston bcas pa spang bar bya/ /khri stan mtho dang khri stan che/ /dus min kha zas spang bar bya/ /ji ltar gso sbyong yan lag brgyad/ /dgra bcom rjes su bdag gis slob/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs ltar/ /rnam dag bdag gis bzung bar bgyi/ /de yis g.yon can bdud las rgyal/ /bla med sangs rgyas mchog thob bya/ /srid pas dub pa'i lus can rnams/ /kun gyi skyabs su 'gyur bar shog

/srid pa de srid ji srid du/ /'khor gyi 'jig rten phan dga' ba'i/ /blo ldan skyes bu de gshegs skyes/ /legs pa rnams dang 'grogs par shog / ces lan gsum rjes bzlos byar gzhug bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang*/ yan lag brgyad pa 'di rab byung la ma byas kyang chog par sems so/ / bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /gang gi shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi zad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / de nas sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes bzlos byar gzhug ste/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge ba rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kya ིsa bzung*/ / lan gsum/ slob ma gdong byang du phyogs pa'i gnas gsum du thig le bkod/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ rnams sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar yang gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le bkod la brtan par bya/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ hūṃ sogs kyis mchod pa lnga phul/ hūṃ las byung ba'i so shing byin te/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par 'dor du bcug so so'i dngos grub kyi ltas lung bstan/ khyor chu lan gsum du byin la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dharmā sarba pa paṃ niṣ+tsa a s+ya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa nā ya hūṃ / zhes brjod/ dhīḥ dang ha las byung ba'i rtsa ku sha che chung sngas dang gdan gyi don du byin/

bsrung skud mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa snying po dang hūṃ bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs la dpung par bcing*/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam la ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma yi/ /sngon chad sdig pa byas pa dag /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ / grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ / skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di las/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun kyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du/ /sad ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni dong pas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ /bu kye da ni dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*/ /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la legs par smon/ zhes brjod/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /nang bar rmi lam dris la/ legs na de ma thag tu dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom/ gal te mi 'tshams pa rmi na bsrung ba dang sbyin bsreg gi las byas la slar yang dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/

/gsum pa ni/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i thig skud kha dog sna lnga pa dgu sgril dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i tshad las sor brgyad kyis lhag pa/ rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis bsngags te/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dang*/ sgrub grogs zhe sdang rdo rje mar gyur/ thig skud lte ba'i thad kar drangs/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ khro bo'i lta bas dkyil 'khor bkug ste/ thig skud la thim/ bdud rtsi lngas byug oṃ āḥbha ga wān/ badz+ra swū traṃ a k+ṣo bh+ya pra yats+tsha tsakra sū tra ṇa ya hūṃ / zhes steng du gdabs pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams bskul bar bsam/ a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ pa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣ+ta/ sarba dharma a d+yan ta a nu ga ta sarba dharmaḥ zhes brjod cing sbril nas g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bcings la/ dzaḥ yig gis slob ma la gtad/ oṃ sū tra sa mā yā ma ti kra ma hūṃ / sems can kyi don du khyod kyi dus/ zhes brjod cing*/ ye shes kyi thig rtsa thig brgyad po gdab par bya ste/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin rlung dbang me bden bral/ /srin po rlung ste slob dpon dang*/ /slob ma'i gnas su gnyis gnyis shes/ /tshangs thig gnyis dang logs thig bzhi/ /zur thig gnyis rnams gdab tshul yin/ de bzhin du las thig thig chen brgyad kyang gdab la/ dkyil 'khor khru gang nas khru lnga'i tshad du bya bar gsungs so/ /cha bcu drug rnam par rgyal ba nas brtsams te/ thig gi bya ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas khro bo'i brnyes pa dang bcas pas sgo'i rtsa thig rnams dbye zhing hi hi zhes brjod/ phyir phyung nas/

oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥswāhā/ thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ tshon rtsi rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon sngon po mi g.yo ba nag po dang zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /dkar po gtum po dkar po dang gti mug rdo rje ma/ /ser po gtum po ser po dang phra ma rdo rje ma/ /dmar po gtum po dmar po dang 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ ljang khu gtum po ljang khu dang phrag dog rdo rje ma rnams kyi ngo bor gyur/ rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis bsngags/ /thig gi skabs bzhin ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa mā ya hū ཾ gis bsngags shing*/ mtheb srin gyi mnye/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma ho/ zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dbus su song ste/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid gtum chen drag po yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par bya/ zhes brjod cing*/ dbang ldan nas re kha lnga sgo tshad gcig tsam slob dpon gyis bri bar bya ste/ nang nas nag ljang dmar ser dkar po'i rim pas so/ /phyi nas thig der tshon dgye bar bya ste/ tshon gyi las gzhan rnams zin pa na lha so so'i gdan la dbus su gtso bo'i phyag mtshan ral gri g.yas dang*/ yum gyi gri gug g.yon du 'bri/ /'dab ma rnams la'ang phyag g.yas kyi mtshan dgod par bya ste/ rdzogs par zin pa na/ oṃ āḥ hū ཾ gis tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ /bum pa bcu yod na shar sgo'i g.yas su gtsor bum gnyis/ /gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'god/ bum pa gnyis kho na yin na shar sgo'i g.yas su rnam rgyal/ g.yon du las bum bkod la/ mtha' skor du mchod gtor dang rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan par bya'o/ / hūṃ zhes brjod pa dang gtso bo'i bsnyems pa dang bcas oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod de rgyan rnams byin gyis rlabs/ bzhi pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs song nas/

bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'dug par bsams la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ tshad med bzhi sgom pa yan chad mngon rtogs ltar maṇ+ḍal mchod pa rdzogs par byas/ de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas par bsgom/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i me lces/ zhes pa nas lan gsum gyi mthar/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin rdzogs par bsgom/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis gdod ma nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ sta gon gyi lha gtum po ye shes sems dpa' lha dgu'i sogs nas/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar ye shes shes pa bstim pa'ang gong bzhin no/ / slar yang dbang gi nas/ don grub kyis dbu rgyan/ gyi bar dbang bskur rgyas btab kyangasgrub thabs bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas brtan par byas pa'i phyir las kyi rdo rje gzungs thag rdo rje lha so so'i gnas su bzung la/ slob dpon gyi g.yon pa'i khu tshur me tog dang bcas pas de sne nas bzung ste/ so so'i rang sngags bdun la sogs pa ci rigs par bzla'o/ /mthar dbus su bzung la yi ge brgya pa'ang ci rigs bzla/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes rol pa las/ /kun bzang mchod yon rnam pa thams cad pa/ /mkha' mnyam kun tu mi zad 'byung ba 'dis/ /gtum chen khro bo'i 'khor lo mchog dgyes mdzod/ oṃ shrī tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa pā ri pra wa ra sad ka ra ya ar+gha pra tīts+tsha hū ཾ swāhā/ mchod yon zhes par zhabs bsil ar+ghaṃ zhes par pat+yaṃ/ de bzhin du/ zhal bsil dang */ añtsa ma ni 'thor 'thung dang*/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ sbyar ro/ / kun tu bzang po'i 'byor pas yongs bzung nas/ /rnam mang me tog mchod sprin lhun stug pa/

/yid 'ong rig ma'i dga' ston gyur pa yang*/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ shrī tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa pā ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ tshig rkang gnyis pa la/ dri zhim bdug spos sprin phung rab 'khrigs pa/ dhu pe= mun sel snang byed 'phreng ba rab 'bar ba/ ā lo ke= /gdung sel dri bzang chu rgyun rab bstar pa/ gan+dhe= bcud ldan zhal zas ji snyed rab bkod pa/ nai wi te/ snyan 'gyur sna tshogs rol mo rab sbyar ba/ shap+ta ces 'don pa spo/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su sogs sgeg sogs brgyad/ mchod lha bcu drug dang*/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga dang*/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ /gos zung la sogs pa 'bul/ /nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs dgos te/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ zhes pa nas oṃ āḥ hūṃ / lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa a tsa la hūṃ phaṭa sogs so so'i mtshan sngags kyis nang mchod phul/ spros pa la dga' na dang por rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la 'bul ba dang*/ lha tshogs kyi gzhug tu chos skyong srung ma phyogs skyong dang rigs drug sogs la 'bul ba yang byas pas legs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang 'di ltar/ rdo rje 'chang dbang na gā rdzu na dang*/ /shā pā ra dbang klu yi byang chub dang*/ /shākya srung ba chos kyi grags pa dang*/ /rin chen bzang po rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rol ba'i rdo rje dang*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyi ma seng ge dang*/ /sangs rgyas dbyangs dang shākya seng ge ya ི/ /rgyal mtshan zhes dang nags kyi rin chen dang*/ /rong po rje dang blo gros chos skyong dang*/ /shākya mchog ldan sangs rgyas 'od zer dang*/ /rje btsun grol mchog chos sku lha dbang zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥ hūṃ a kā ro lan mang du brjod/ mgon khyod bkres skyem mi mnga' yang*/ /'o thug bur khu sbrang rtsi'i chu//

lhan skyes sbyar dang yongs gyur pa/ /rnam pa mang po'i btung bas mchod/ badz+ra pī pa thā/ bdud rtsi lnga'i bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog pañtsha a mṛ ta/ sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi dam tshig gtso/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i sku mnga' yongs rdzogs thob par shog pañtsa pra dī pa/ sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru yi chang*/ /shing las skyes dang bcos ma'i chang*/ /shes rab rang bzhin myos byed lngas/ /gsang sngags lha la mchod par bgyi/ pañtsha ma da na/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*/ /dmangs rigs mthar skyes las byung ba/ /bde chen bskyed byed rig ma lnga/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /pañtsa mu dra/ de nas bstod pa ni/ khyab 'jug phye mar 'thag par byed cing*/ sogs dang*/ 'od 'phro gtum pa'i spyan dang 'jigs rung= sogs dang*/ gtum po khros pa'i= sogs kyi mthar/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ / bgegs rnams bsdu zhing mthar mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo gcig pu'i sku/ /sku gsum gcig pa la phyag 'tshal/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis thabs dag gi/ rang bzhin shes rab ral gri 'phyar/ /g.yon na shes rab dngos po yi/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni zhags pa 'dzin/ /sa 'og bdun po bskyong ba'i phyir/ /g.yon pa'i spyan gyis 'og tu gzigs/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nga bdun bskya ོ da sla da / /g.yas pas steng gzigs la phyag 'tshal/ /de ni sa gzhi bsrung ba'i phyir/ /g.yon pa'i pus mo bzhag mdzad de/ /bdud rnams rab tu spong ba'i dbyibs/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod mgon por de mtshon phyir/ /rin chen cod pan gos bkra ba'i/ /klubs shing zhe sdang rdo rje mar/ /snyoms zhugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /longs spyod bskyed pa'i snying po yi/ /pho nya'i dgra 'joms mdung gi phyag /nyi ma bye ba las lhag 'od/

/dpal ldan gtum drag la phyag 'tshal/ /a yig gis ni stonganyid brjod/ /tsa yig gis kyang bde ba che/ /la yig gis ni de dag gcig /de phyir mi g.yo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /brgyad gnyis lon pas yongs gang ba/ /mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig dngos/ /chags bral gyis kyang mi g.yo nyid/ /de yi phyir yang khyod la 'dud/ /chags bral la ni gtum zhes bya/ /de ni bdud la drag po'o/ / bde ba'i rgyal po 'char ba ste/ /de phyir gtum drag khyod phyag 'tshal/ / brgyad po gang zhig 'char ba na/ /yul dbang lhan cig 'gro 'gyur pa/ /rdzogs pa'i kun du dga' ba'i thabs/ /de la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa kun kyi mchog ldan pa/ /phyag rgya chen po 'gyur med bdag /me long la ni pra phab bzhin/ /snang ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod la bstod kyang ma bstod de/ / mtshon par dka' yang dga' bskyed phyir/ /bdag gi bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis phal cher mi g.yor 'gyur/ zhes pas kyang bstod par bya'o/ /de nas rlung kha sbyor bzung ba sogs kun du spyod pa yid la dran par bya/ gru bzhi tshangs pa'i zhes pa nas bar+dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar dag dran dang bzlas pa bya/ lnga pa ni/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ oṃ swā bhā wa nas/ mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥ hū ཾ / btags pas nang mchod phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog ces pa'i bar brjod do/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'ang skabs 'di nyid du 'bul bar bya'o/ /de nas gtso bo las rang 'dra ba gnyis pa chad de gtor ma'i las mdzad par bsam la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu phyogs skyong dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gi cho gas phyi rol gtor ma btang la/ bgegs bskrad de nang du 'ong*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta su la li ta sogs kyis gtso bo la me tog dor/ oṃ badz+ra ud+gha ṭa ya sa mā ya pra be sha ya hūṃ / lan bzhis sgo dbye/

sa mā ya pra be sha ya mī/ me tog mgo la bzhag sems can rnams la dngos su thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig ces gsol ba btab/ de nas 'grub na spyin sreg gi mchod pa bya ste/ de'i cho ga ni 'od kyi snyem rab lta'o/ /drug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bdag rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa rā ma na ya hūṃ/ gis mig dar/ āḥkhaṃ wi ra hūṃ/ gis me tog snying gar rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ nag po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ / kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /snying gar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhi gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ 'dir spro na 'phreng ba las 'byung ba'i bskor ba dang*/ phyag 'tshal bdun po rnams bya'o// bsdus pa la mos na/ oṃ na masta ེ hūṃ / oṃ na mo me hūṃ / oṃ na mo na ma hūṃ / zhes bya/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ / gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/

/oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par dus kyi bya ba byas nas dmyal bar lhung par 'gyur ta re/ de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ rang skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las ā yig las byung ba'i snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa/ rdo rjes mtshan par nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ mgo bor paṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan par zla ba la ha dkar po/ mgrin par yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu g.yo ba'i ba dan gnyis kyis mtshan par zla ba la āḥ dmar po rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis sku dang gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ hū ཾ ha āḥ yig rnams la thim/ rkang pa dag gi 'og nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor kyis sbar ba'i raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa yi ge ras mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiṃḥyig dmar pos 'degs bzhin par gyur pa'i dzhaiṃḥyig gi 'od zer gyi tshogs rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pa rnams dang*/ yi ge hūṃ la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis lus mtha' dag kun nas gang bar gyur/ ā be ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya hūṃ haḥ.āḥdzhaiṃḥ rang gi 'dod pa'i don dang mthun pa'i dngos grub kyi ltas nam mkha'i kha dog kyang mthong bar mos/

slob ma dbang bskur skabs kha dog 'dri zhing lan 'debs/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams ji ltar de ltar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /traṃ las byung ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba/ oṃ tiṣ+ta badz+ra tri ṭ+doha me bha wa shā shwa to me bha wa hri da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ta sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ ā khaṃ bī ra hū ཾ / pra tīts+tsha ku su mañdza lin+nā tha ho/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /phye bas dbang po thams cad pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dzña na tsak+ṣu hūṃ āḥswāhā/ kye rdo rje ltos shig rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ /dngos grub kun gyi phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje pad+ma mchog rol bas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyis/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor da

kyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur/ sa ma ya ho ho hoḥ rig pa'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyir rol tu khrus kyi khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa sgo nub tu bstan pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bdag nyid gtso bo'i rnam pa dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas gnas par gyur/ oṃ āḥtsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa sarba bigh+nā nu ta sā da ya hū ཾ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bdag gi lus la reg pas 'od kyi phung por 'gyur/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar thon te thams cad stong pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid las skad cig gis hūṃ dang ral gri yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gtum po chen po nag po shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ spro na mngon rtogs bzhin zhal phyag gsal gdab bo/ / mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khro bo gtum po'i rnam par spyan drangs te rang nyid la thim/ slar yang thug ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rig pa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum de rnams snyaums par zhugs pas/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam par gyur/ /gtso bo'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur te rangagi sgo gsum dri ma bral zhing dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ pad+ma'i mtha' nas phyir phyung bas dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/

byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab tu gyur pa rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa rig pa'i lha mo sems dpa' sems ma khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur pa mkha' nang nas phyir phyung ste/ dbang bskur ba'i don du nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ gur gum dang tsan dan dang me tog la sogs pa'i char 'bebs par byed/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar 'dzin pa'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur bzhin pa dang*/ lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun kyi bdag nyid rigs kun gy-i ni bdag po mchog / sems can ma lus skyes byed bde ba chen po ste/ /de ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oṃ phun tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ zhes sogs brjod/ shing gi yal gas bum chu blangs shing spyi bor gtor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ / zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang bde ba chen po myong zhing dri ma thams cad dag par gyur/ chu'i dbang ngo*/ bdag nyid mi g.yo ba ser po'i 'khor los bsgyur pa'i ngo bo gyur/ dbu rgya na stong pa'i ngang las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po rin po che dang dril bu mdzin par gyur/ de zhu ba las rin po che'i dbus rgyan tu gyur/ oṃ tsa ṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ā bi sha ā bi sha a s+ya hṛ da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sngon bzhin chu dbang bskur ro/ / bdag nyid mi g.yo ba dmar po'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i ngo bor gyur/ dbang rdzas ral gri stong pa'i ngang las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i ral grir gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na mā ra ya mā ra ya sarba sha truṃ dzñā na khaḍ+ga hūṃ phaṭa/ sngon bzhin chu dbang bskur/

rang nyid mi g.yo ba ljang khu'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i ngo bor gyur/ dbang rdzas zhags pa stong pa'i ngang las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i zhags par gyur/ o gṛh+na gṛh+na ka ta ka ta kat+t+ya kat+t+ya sarba duṣ+taṃ pā she na ban+dha ban+dha ma hā sa t+ya te dharma ta swāhā/ yang gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ rang nyid mi g.yo ba dkar po'i 'khor los ba sgyu ra ba'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ he shrī bha ga wan kṛṣ+ṇa a tsa la sid+dhi twaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gal te mi g.yo ba dkar po la me tog phog pa yin na/ kṛṣ+ṇa 'i gnas su shwe ta sbyar ba la sogs pa shes par bya'o/ /bdag 'jug gi bya ba la gnas pa'i gang zag kyang bud med yin na dbang phyi ma bzhi po 'di dag las tha dad du bya ba'i tshul yang slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs su 'chad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /dbang 'di rnams bskur bas bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud mtha' dag nyan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ sngags sgrub pa rnams la dbang bar 'gyur ro rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang/ /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pa'i bar gyis rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur ba/ / rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*/ /thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/

lan gsum/ dbang stegs kyi steng du bdag nyid hūṃ dang rdo rje las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ / rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzangapo kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /āḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bar bzhed/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yi/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan pa nyid/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /de na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /ye shes phyag rgya'i byin rlabs nas/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub par byos/ /rang nyid mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rig ma mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor mos la/ kha sbyor gyi rim pas rjes su chags pa dang bcas pa 'khyud pa tsam las byung ba'i bde ba rang rig pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don to/ / shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ / lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyis ni dbang du brjod/ de nas bum chu blangs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ / gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sbyin par bgyi/ oṃ sarba nas/ bde ba chen po myong ba'i bar gong bzhin/

bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha pa badz+re swāhā/ puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ lha rnams ni ye shes lnga dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi'i bdag nyid do/ / snying po'i sngags lan gsum bzlas la/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ / bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi rgyud la mi g.yo gtum po khro bo'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /de ltar na bum pa'i dbang thob pas sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku mngon du byas pa yin no/ / gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa'i shes rab ma phul bar mos/ khyod la 'di ni 'bul lags kyi/ /'dod don bde ba rab tu stsol/ / bdag ni 'dod pa'i bde don phyir/ /mgon po khyod kyi brtse bas bzung*/ zhes lan gsum/ gong bzhin mig dar bcing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snying po'i sngags bzla bzhin du/ rjes chags kyi snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems g.yon pa'i phyag gi mthe bong dang ming med kyi blangs te/ bdag gi lce la/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi rnam par bkod/ oṃ āḥ hū ཾ / bdud rtsi myang*/ ā ho ma hā su khaṃ/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ de ring bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ gang gis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rab tu mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur gyi/ 'on kyang khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du 'di smra bar mi bya'o/

/ zhes dang*/ ral gri'i phyag rgya snying gar bzhag ste/ gal te smra na de yi tshe/ /shin tu rno ba'i ral gri 'di/ khro bo gtum po'i phyag na gnas/ /gang gis dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ de la 'di yis mchog tu gcod/ /skye ba bye ba stong rnams su/ /mi rnams ral gri lag phyar bas/ /yan lag kun gcod mgo bo ni/ /gcod la gcig tu 'bad par byed/ / gal te dam tshig dral gyur na/ khyod kyang de ltar 'gyur ba yin/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ gong bzhin me tog phul/ gong bzhin gdong g.yogs bsal/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas pa blta ste/ de las byung ba'i bde ba ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo*/ /de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byas/ shes rab ye shes kyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsang dbang gi skabs ltar gsol ba btab/ dbang phyi ma 'di gnyis la mig dar 'ching ba mi mdzad do/ / slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bdag nyid la rigs dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya gtad la/ bzang mo yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsngags/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig de la dang po 'khyud pa dang tsum pa la sogs pa phyi'i bya ba sna tshogs pa las thob pa'i bde ba ni dga' ba dang po'o/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba las mchog tu dga' ba'o/ / bsrub cing bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las byang chub kyi sems gtsug tor nas nor bu'i mgul bar son pa'i bar ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /bde ba rgyun chad cing sngon bde bar snang ba dran pa ni dga' bral gyi dga' ba'o/ / de nas shes rab ma phyogs kyi gos can ma gcer bur gnas pa'i gsang ba'i chu skyes gsal bar byas te/ ci ste bu khyod 'di spro'am/ / nga las mi gtsang len pa ni/ / bshang gci rak+ta za ba dang*/ /bha ga'i mtha' nas 'jib byed dam/

zhes dris pa la/ khyod las dam tshig bza' bar ni/ /ci yi phyir na bdag mi spro/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gis mi mo kun gus bya/ /des kyang bdag nyid bde ba chen po la gus par rigs nas/ ā ho bdag gi pad+ma ni bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /bdag la dngos grub stsol mdzad ma/ /dal bus dal bus rab sbyor ba/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ zhes smra zhing ltos pa med par lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ched du sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dang rig ma zhe sdang rdo rje mar gyur/ shes rab kyi mkha' zhes pa nas/ oṃ ā hū ཾ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ snyoms par zhugs pa las lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de nas 'dzag par sems pa na/ sems gcig pur ni rengs 'gyur nas/ /bde ba bskyed byed mi g.yo ba/ /mi tshor ba yi sems kyis bsgom/ /de ltar na shes rab ye shes dbang thob pas/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku mngon du byas/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dngos po dang dngos med thams cad bral ba shes rab dang thabs yang dag par sbyor ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dpal mi g.yo mgon po'i bdag nyid can dga' ba bzhi gcig pa'i sku/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa'i thugs thar ba ni/ 'dod chags chen po las skye bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten pa'i chags pa zad pa las zad par gyur pa mi g.yo ba'i don yongs su shes pas sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub rab tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / zhes brjod cing de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag / de ltar na dbang bzhi pa thob pas sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du byas so/ / bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/

khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*/ / phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃsarba ta thā ga tā sid+dhi sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+wan+dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ / 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan bgyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las rab bton/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ti sid+dha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur+bhu wa swa/ 'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas/ /sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ chos kyi gnas su rdo rje rin chen/ pad+ma/ las kyi zhes pa rnams bcug shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas/ /skyo med dogs dang bral ba yi/ / de ltar sems can don gyis shig /da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ / lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la brtse don du/ / khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhi na / /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa na/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas/

/bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu mthar grub bo/ /'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du kyis/ / 'gro ba bde ba nyung la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / / mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur / / deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su deng bdag 'gyur/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs dam tshig khas blang*/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjaud/ bdun pa ni spyi dang mthun par dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs/ /de nas cho ga'i bya ba rnams ni bdag sgom pa dang*/ gzhan la dmigs pa 'bogs pa'i khyad par ma gtogs bdag 'jug gi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ dngapo yol bas bcad/ gsang gdams song ma thag yol ba'i nang du bcug /lha ngo bstan pa'i skabs su mngon rtogs dang bstun pa'i rgyas bsdud ci rigs pa bshad pa la/ dkyil 'khor chen po mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod bud med la dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ cod pan la sogs pa'i dbang rnams 'di lta ste/ sin+dhu ra'i thig le smin mtshams su byin la/ rgyal srid kyi btsun mo chen po'i gzugs su dmigs nas dar dpyangs bcings te/ oṃ bha ga wa tī ā bi sha ā bi sha a s+ya hri da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ / ral gri'i gnas su lcags kyu gri gug byin la/ oṃ karti ke sarba mā ra ṇi/ maṃ sa kartā ya karta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ zhags pa'i dod du thod pa byin la/ oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sarba sha tru ṇāṃ/ rak+taṃ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ ming dbang gi skabs su/ oṃ shrī dwe ṣa badz+ri sid+dhā s+t+waṃ hū ཾ phaṭa/ de bzhin du rigs kyi dbye bas/

mo ha badz+ra sogs sbyar/ 'di dag tu ser sna rdo rje ma la sogs pa lha'i nga rgyal 'pho bar bya'o/ /spros pa la dga' na sngags kyi rjes gnang gi mthar mig thur me long mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang dang*/ bzhi pa'i rjes la rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang lung bstan gyi rjes su chos bshad dang/ 'jug tu dbugs 'byung ring po sogs rdo rje 'phreng bas kha skongs mdzad pa phyag len du snang ba shin tu'ang legs pa'o/ /gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ /dngos kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni rgyud nyid las gsal bar 'byung ba bzhin no/ /dbangabaskur ba'i sngon dang tha mar sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i gtor mas mnyes par bya'o/ / phyi nas dkyil 'khor la sngar bzhin du mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ bris sku la sogs pa gzhan dang gzhan la brtan bzhugs byas la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ oṃ āḥka ro mu khaṃ sarba dhārmā ṇaṃ a t+ya nut+pa n+na twa ta/ oṃ āḥ hū ཾ muḥ zhes 'don zhing chos thams cad skye ba med par mos pas dril bu 'khrol zhing lag pa na gnas pa'i rdo rjes shar phyogs nas brtsams te thig lam nas gtso bo'i bar du dbye zhing*/ rdul tshon cung zad rang gi mgo bor blugs nas pad+ma la sogs pa rnams dang*/ sgo dang zur rnams nas dbye bar bya'o/ / de nas skam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu phyung la/ oṃ badz+ra kī lo t+kī la ya/ sarba kī la na badz+ra dha ra a dzñā pa yā hūṃ phaṭa hoḥ oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+dha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas phur khung du 'o mas gtor/

phur bu'i lha gshegs su gsol zhing khung bu bgang*/ de nas rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho'i dbang bzhi'i yid bzhin nor/ /rdo rje'i tshig gi 'od zer ches gsal ba'ang*/ /mtha' dag skye bos nyer spyod ma nus pas/ /blos ldan don mthun gang dag 'dir zhugs kye/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bris pa las/ /bsod nams gang zhig 'dir thob pa/ /de las gtum po khro bo'i rgyal/ /mi g.yo mgon po nyid gyur cig / dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje rol pa zhes bya ba 'di ni don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba dang*/ rgyud sde de nyid la mchog tu mos pa chen pos nye bar drangs te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer brgyad pa la chos 'khor bsam stengs su sbyar ba las/ blo dman gyi don du phyis cung zad 'khyer bde bar byas pa'o/ /dge bas bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ khyad par gtum po khro bo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ // zhus dag/ bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal gtum po khro bo chen po dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje rol ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 42--PAGE 43--PAGE 16-
